question: Can a bounded population of locally updating feature-conditional causal hypotheses discover a reusable action-outcome contract from randomized interventions more efficiently than a pooled or fully factored observation-count control?
hypothesis: A prequential-evidence-gated contract will select an action-dependent public feature on an action-interaction world, retain exact predictions across serialization, and avoid spurious specialization on a null world. This is a synthetic development screen, not evidence of general intelligence or causal identifiability.

inputs.name: positive synthetic intervention world
inputs.source: In-memory bits x0,x1,a iid Bernoulli(1/2) drawn by Python random.Random with frozen seeds; public y = a XOR x0; actions selected randomly, not inferred from hidden state; world label not sent to learner.

inputs.name: null synthetic intervention world
inputs.source: Same public iid bits; public y=a; x0,x1 are distractors; world label not sent to learner. Deterministic code identity pinned by implementation SHA before outcome execution.

frozen_design.split: Train 192 independent randomized observed (x0,x1,a,y) transitions per seed and world; fixed, nonlearning evaluation on 256 independent transitions using random.Random(seed+100000). World generators do not share PRNG state.
frozen_design.ordering: Train from RNG draw order. For each transition, compute pre-update predictions of pooled, each singleton-feature candidate, and full-table controls, then update counts. After sufficient observations, structural choice may activate exactly one feature-conditional candidate. Do not inspect heldout predictions for selection.
frozen_design.data_budget: 2 worlds x 5 seeds x (192 train + 256 evaluation) = 4480 events, of which 1920 update learner; separate tests may use synthetic hand fixtures but no primary heldout events.
frozen_design.compute_budget: CPython stdlib only; each event may update pooled, two 1-feature candidate counters, and one 2-feature full-table control. No model APIs or external compute. No hyperparameter searches or extra evals.
frozen_design.capacity: Exactly 2 candidate feature cells, at most 1 selected structural split, 2 binary actions/outcomes, public x0,x1. No births, unrestricted growth, training oracle, third feature, or unbounded causal graph. Beta(1,1) posterior predictive.
frozen_design.evaluator: Frozen heldout Brier score: average (predicted P(y=1) - observed y)^2 without evaluation updates; comparator is min(pooled Brier, full-table Brier) on the positive world, aggregated per-seed then averaged; null false split count; checkpoint prediction equality across all eight public (x0,x1,a) configurations.
frozen_design.structural_trigger: At least 48 transitions and at least 6 observed events in each public (feature-bit, action) cell; candidate prequential Brier cumulative improvement over pooled at least max(2.0,0.01*N); select best gain, ties by lower feature index, permanently freeze selection. No feature ID is supplied by the environment.

controls: Pooled Beta-Bernoulli action-only predictor trained on identical public examples
Full-context Beta-Bernoulli x0,x1,action table trained on same public examples
Null world with no relevant feature (false-split negative control)
Corrupt checkpoint and malformed event rejection unit tests
metrics: positive-world heldout Brier: candidate, pooled, full table
selected feature index and selection step
resident entry counts, serialized byte size, training/eval counts

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL only: across five preregistered positive seeds, average candidate Brier <= average per-seed min(pooled, full) Brier - 0.005, chosen feature index 0 in >=4/5 positive seeds, no splits in >=4/5 null seeds, and 5/5 exact cold checkpoint predictions. Never label SCIENTIFIC_PASS on this synthetic screen.
classification_rules.mixed: Benefit threshold passes but one of split/null/checkpoint conditions fails, or only some seeds improve; preserve all negatives without policy revision.
classification_rules.negative: When all identities valid and evaluator executes but supported/mixed conditions are not met. Report strongest control wins and all negative seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: Any data leakage, generator rule supplied to learner, wrong parent/protocol/code identity, heldout use for model selection, changed frozen budgets or thresholds, missing baseline, contradictory counts, serialization mismatch, or unauthorized run.

prohibited_after_primary_run: extra data/compute/model calls unless separately preregistered
repair of a negative by rerunning different settings
preregistration_note: Pre-implementation and pre-primary-result freeze. This exploratory architecture is not independently admitted first-use science. No production, branch promotion, or runner dispatch.
